title: Voronoi L-decomposition of PSD_n and the Hypermetric Correlation Cone
relevance: Directly treats membership in the hypermetric correlation cone, equivalent to nonnegativity of the associated inhomogeneous integer quadratic form. It states membership is in co-NP and explicitly says NP-hardness was unknown (pp. 3–4). This is a useful direct status source, not prior hardness; it gives no equivalent X3C/circumsphere reduction.

title: Interior Point and Semidefinite Approaches in Combinatorial Optimization
venue: Graph Theory and Combinatorial Optimization, pp. 101–157, Springer
relevance: Potential false-positive prior-art citation: p. 33 says checking violated hypermetric inequalities is NP-hard, but supplies no reduction and cites Avis (2003) and Avis–Grishukhin (1993), whose full-problem statements say complexity is unknown. Its displayed max-cut family a^T X a >= 1 with odd sign-sum is rounded-psd under the terminology in the supplied note, so this does not establish all-gonality pure hypermetric hardness.

title: Contributions to Determining Exact Ground-States of Ising Spin-Glasses and to their Physics
relevance: Potential false-positive prior-art citation: p. 23 states that separating hypermetric inequalities is NP-hard, but gives no proof there and cites Deza–Laurent (1997); the cited chapter says the exact complexity was unknown and only smallest-violated-gonality was NP-hard. Record as an unsupported secondary assertion, not as a result that establishes arbitrary separation or an equivalent construction.
